verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own marketing directly claims installing on older hardware improves performance and extends device lifespan, matching the story almost verbatim, but this is a single first-party marketing line with no independent benchmarks, hardware compatibility lists, or lightweight-desktop-variant guidance to substantiate it. Community evidence discusses desktop environment experiences but does not address old-hardware performance claims. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks/testimonials on old hardware, specific low-resource install guidance (e.g., minimal/flavor recommendations), and hands-on corroboration of extended device lifespan.
